section: noncomputable section; open Set; namespace BanditRL.OnlineConvex
owned_normal_definition:
def SourceNormalCone (V : Set E) (x : E) : Set E :=
  {g | x ∈ V ∧ ∀ y ∈ V, inner ℝ g (y - x) ≤ 0}
borrowed_support_definition:
def SourceSubdifferential (f : E → EReal) (x : E) : Set E :=
  {g | ∀ y, f x + (inner ℝ g (y - x) : EReal) ≤ f y}
borrowed_indicator_definition:
def extendedIndicator (V : Set E) (x : E) : EReal := by
  classical
  exact if x ∈ V then 0 else ⊤
